thread:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to replace the old 'usage policy' examples with the new metering schema (v3). goal: one clear example each for tiered plans, burst credits, and how the dashboard maps usage bins. pinging @Maria for API header copy.
Maria Gomez: thanks alex. can we also add an SDK snippet for both JS and Go? customers keep asking how to read consumption vs quota programmatically.
Devin Patel: +1 on SDKs. Also we should demonstrate the edge-case where a request is counted against the reserve pool (burst) but then moved to committed after reconciliation.
Alex Chen: agreed. i'll add a short section called "Burst vs Committed: what you pay" with a tiny table and a sample query for the usage analytics API.
Samir Rao: small nit — the header we settled on in the spec is `X-RW-Consumption` not the old `X-Redwood-Limit`. make sure examples use the new header and show both success and 429 handling.
Maria Gomez: noted. for the snippet let's show reading headers and falling back to the `/usage` endpoint. example JS snippet:
```js
// get quota info from headers
const quota = response.headers.get('X-RW-Consumption') || await fetch('/v1/usage?key=...')
```
Alex Chen: nice. For the Go snippet, keep it tiny:
```go
h := resp.Header.Get("X-RW-Consumption")
if h == "" { /* call /v1/usage */ }
```
Devin Patel: can we include a short dashboard panel image alt text and a PromQL example? Some customers want to map the dashboard panel to raw metrics.
Alex Chen: yep — i'll paste the promql and alt text. promql example:
```
sum by (tier) (rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[5m]))
```
Maria Gomez: acceptance criteria for the PR?
Alex Chen: 1) update all examples to use `X-RW-Consumption`; 2) add JS + Go snippets; 3) include the reconciliation note and small table; 4) add promql and a note about timezone alignment; 5) run quick link check (dashboard, API reference, migration guide).
Samir Rao: also add a short troubleshooting blurb: "If you see missing header, use `/v1/usage` and compare `window_start` to local time; common cause is clock skew." saves us some support tickets.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/docs/replace-usage-examples-3581234567 (alex) :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: i'll review tonight and leave inline comments on wording. can someone else sanity-check the promql and the dashboard panel copy?
Devin Patel: i'll check promql and the dashboard copy tomorrow morning. if all good i'll approve.
Alex Chen: thanks — i'll wait for the two approvals then merge and file a follow-up to run the link crawler.
Samir Rao: FYI i'm going to schedule a tiny playbook update in our support runbook after merge, one-paragraph note about header names + where to look in the console for tier usage.
Maria Gomez: perfect. tagging release note: docs: metering v3 examples + SDK snippets (internal-only) — will QA that before public rollout.
Alex Chen: all right, closing thread here once PR is green. :thumbsup:
